video_title: Mark Cuban Welcomes Von Miller Back To Dallas

quotes.speaker: Von Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Von Miller on the Dallas Cowboys' status as a sports franchise
quotes.excerpt: Dallas Cowboys the most valuable sports franchise in the world
quotes.quote: Dallas Cowboys the most valuable sports franchise in the world. Over the Yankees, over the Boston Red Sox, over Manchester United, over the Lakers, it is the most valuable sports franchise in the world and you feel it, especially for me, being a Dallas Cowboys fan my whole entire life.

quotes.speaker: Von Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Von Miller on his role and compensation with the Buffalo Bills
quotes.excerpt: They're paying me and my contract is what it is to be the locker room guy
quotes.quote: They're paying me and my contract is what it is to be the locker room guy, to be a great teammate. They're paying me to be on the team, to be the best teammate that I can possibly be and help these guys with whatever it may be, kind of bring some of that Super Bowl culture that I've been a part of my whole entire career.

quotes.speaker: Von Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Von Miller on negotiating his jersey number with Hunter Luepke
quotes.excerpt: I was able to get number 40 from Hunter Luepke, which we had to kind of do some negotiating
quotes.quote: I was able to get number 40 from Hunter Luepke, which we had to kind of do some negotiating in first. He's been 40 for a long time, so it ain't something that I just can come in and boss hog. When I talked to him about it, I hit him on Instagram and he was like, we can figure something out. I came with the idea, I give him chicken for life. And of course, being a great negotiator he is, he was like, how about equity in Greener Pastures Chicken?

quotes.speaker: TJ Banks
quotes.summary_phrase: TJ Banks on Deion Sanders' legal issues with the 49ers
quotes.excerpt: Deion Sanders comes out of retirement, he signs with the Los Angeles Rams
quotes.quote: Deion Sanders comes out of retirement, he signs with the Los Angeles Rams for a one-year $20 million deal, up to $30 million in bonuses. He has scammed over 26 women out of money, $1.3 million. The FBI arrested them, so it's a federal case.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the sports culture in Dallas
quotes.excerpt: We love sports, first of all, right? It starts in high school
quotes.quote: We love sports, first of all, right? It starts in high school. It's all about football, a little bit more so about basketball now and other sports, but everybody in this town played or looked up to sports when they were growing up. In Dallas, the Cowboys are king. I love the Mavs, the Mavs are catching up a little bit, but the Cowboys are king and when you have a great sports town with great teams like the Cowboys, the Mavs, the Stars, the Rangers, people fall in love with them.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the pitfalls of being a public influencer
quotes.excerpt: My daughter was kind of an influencer online and we were doing something on TikTok during the pandemic
quotes.quote: My daughter was kind of an influencer online and we were doing something on TikTok during the pandemic and I got more views than her and I said something to her about it and she was 16 years old, 17 years old and I realized immediately I had screwed up. You're not supposed to be competitive with your kids.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the competitive nature of business vs sports
quotes.excerpt: In business, it's 24 by 7 by 365 and some 12-year-old kid can come in
quotes.quote: In business, it's 24 by 7 by 365 and some 12-year-old kid can come in and try to kick your ass and you're not going to see it coming. You're always competing. That's why I love business, man. You can't shut it off, you cannot turn it off ever.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the importance of sales in business
quotes.excerpt: No business has ever succeeded without sales. Whether you're a podcast, whether you're Free Range
quotes.quote: No business has ever succeeded without sales. Whether you're a podcast, whether you're Free Range, whatever it is, you got to have sales. That's what drives everything and when I look at an investment and the person bringing it to me says, okay, I'm just the tech guy or I'm just the chef, I'm like, well, who's going to be out there selling it? Who's going to be out front bringing people through the door, making them, you know, give you your credit card?

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on his lack of patience for failure
quotes.excerpt: I hate to suck, you know? I just don't have the patience to be bad
quotes.quote: I hate to suck, you know? I just don't have the patience to be bad.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the importance of transparency in pharmacy
quotes.excerpt: We were the first transparent pharmacy basically. We show you our costs, we show you our markup
quotes.quote: We were the first transparent pharmacy basically. We show you our costs, we show you our markup, our prices are lower and no one had ever done that, believe it or not. Just so simple, but it was able to change the whole game.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the future of AI in the workforce
quotes.excerpt: People think that AI kills jobs, it doesn't. It's people who know how to use AI better
quotes.quote: People think that AI kills jobs, it doesn't. It's people who know how to use AI better than you that takes your job. And if you learn how to use AI well, even if you're an accountant, but I think accounting probably has some of the greatest risk of any industry.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the importance of being a good leader
quotes.excerpt: The more you understand your guys, the more you understand chemistry in the locker room
quotes.quote: The more you understand your guys, the more you understand chemistry in the locker room. The more you understand the locker room, the more you understand how to put together a team. And I think sometimes where things go crosswise, guys have to focus on their career and try to figure out what's best for them and I think not all owners respect that. I always tried to respect that and always tried to, you know, recognize that players can't play forever. Father Time is undefeated.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the importance of being authentic
quotes.excerpt: Just stay true to who I am, right? Just, you know, hanging out with my same friends
quotes.quote: Just stay true to who I am, right? Just, you know, hanging out with my same friends. My high school boys are still my friends, the guys I lived with or came and hung out with in Dallas are still my best friends.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the importance of being good at what you do
quotes.excerpt: I heard a great saying, right? Someone once told me, be so good you don't have to introduce yourself
quotes.quote: I heard a great saying, right? Someone once told me, be so good you don't have to introduce yourself.

quotes.speaker: Von Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Von Miller on his goal to win three Super Bowls with three teams
quotes.excerpt: One of my personal goals of mine is to win three Super Bowls with three different teams
quotes.quote: One of my personal goals of mine is to win three Super Bowls with three different teams. Nobody's ever done it. Matt Millen, he won with three different teams, but on his third team for the Super Bowl, he was inactive, so he didn't like actually play in the game. But nobody has played on three different teams and played in three different Super Bowls in NFL history and that that is a dream for mine.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Managing a college sports team is harder than an NBA team
quotes.excerpt: managing a college football team or basketball team for that matter is harder than an NBA team
quotes.quote: They're both professional sports teams. The only difference is there's a five-year max on how many years a kid can play for you. But they're both pro and it's managing a college football team or basketball team for that matter is harder than an NBA team, because you can leave after one year, you can go to the transfer portal, and even worse, one of the hardest things with the Mavs was when a kid came in that we drafted young, 19, 20 years old, had no idea about money.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: College football recruiting is about current, not future, productivity
quotes.excerpt: it was about current productivity and they brought in players who already were experienced
quotes.quote: They brought in coaches who knew that they were pro coaches. They knew that they were going to have a guy one year, maybe two years. And so they weren't trying to create future productivity. There was not about potential. It was about current productivity and they brought in players who already were experienced, who knew their roles. They weren't bringing in the four or five stars, because the four or five stars, particularly the five stars, wanted to be part of a bidding war.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: College football success requires players with high football IQ
quotes.excerpt: it's about getting guys who you know have enough football knowledge or basketball IQ
quotes.quote: It's not about winning the summer, it's not about winning the portal. It's about getting guys who you know have enough football knowledge or basketball IQ to be coached quickly into a system that they can pick up. Because it doesn't matter what your 40 is, it doesn't matter how quick you are, it doesn't matter how strong or your technique is, if you can't pick up this new system fast enough, you aren't going to play.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on being misjudged by his bank account
quotes.excerpt: people just presume by my bank account they know what I'm about
quotes.quote: People just presume by my bank account they know what I'm about, and that's just not the case. You don't know me. My family knows me, my friends know me. You don't know me, and what bothers me the most is that people presume they do because of my bank account. I think I'm chill. My friends are my same friends. If you talk to them, they'll tell you I'm the same, I'm still a slob, I still think I can cook with a microwave.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban's advice on dealing with fans
quotes.excerpt: just take the picture, it takes two seconds, sign the autograph, be nice, just be chill
quotes.quote: You stop and you take the pictures. It takes more time not to take a picture and explain why and have them get, just take the picture. It takes two seconds, sign the autograph, be nice, just be chill, just fit in, you're nothing special. You're just one more guy that really is blessed and enjoy your blessings because not everybody's got those things.

quotes.speaker: Mark Cuban
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban on the impact of Cost Plus Drugs
quotes.excerpt: Cost Plus Drugs is what I'm most proud of because we're literally saving lives
quotes.quote: I think Cost Plus Drugs is what I'm most proud of because we're literally saving lives. We're taking people who couldn't afford their medication and making it affordable to them, things that cost hundreds or thousands of dollars and making them 10, 20, 30 dollars. And so when you do that and you get the emails and the letters and people stop you and you hear that, I mean, just the chance, running and owning the Mavs, winning and championship, that brings a city together and that's all amazing, but when you get to literally save somebody's life or allow them to stay healthy, there's no replacement for that.
